genuine_vendor_definition: The company's own product statement (one_liner or description) says it SELLS software or an operated service whose primary purpose is: (a) handling customer support/customer service for other businesses (helpdesk, ticketing, AI or human support agents, support QA/training/knowledge-base tooling, contact-center/call-center software); (b) internal IT/HR/employee helpdesk; or (c) production/IT incident response and on-call. Same definition as evidence/eval/labels.json 'vendor'.
